# Public API

The public API centers on `RpcClient` and generic JSON-RPC contracts exported from `src/index.ts`.

```ts
import { RpcClient } from '@beblurt/blurt-rpc-core'

const rpc = new RpcClient('https://rpc.example.org')
const result = await rpc.call('namespace.method', { limit: 10 })
```

## Main operations

- `call(method, params?, options?)`: resolves with the JSON-RPC result by default.
- `callRaw(method, params?, options?)`: resolves with the parsed JSON-RPC response.
- `notify(method, params?, options?)`: sends a JSON-RPC notification.
- `callBatch(items, options?)`: sends a JSON-RPC batch and preserves item-level errors.

## Extension points

- custom transport;
- retry policy and backoff strategy;
- node-pool strategy;
- explicit cache provider;
- lifecycle hooks;
- metrics collector;
- serializer/parser;
- id factory;
- injected fetch implementation.

## Non-goals

No blockchain, scoring, signatures, health checks, method-specific behavior or MCP server code belongs here.
